Hangover🫠? A spoonful of chili oil and seafood make everything hotter and better.🔥 Shrimp heads, soft tofu, crab, octopus, and juicy shrimp simmer into a rich, spicy broth that’s guaranteed to bring you back to life❤️‍🔥 Would you try this after a night out?🍜✨ 📍 Tag your late-night buddy & save this recipe for your next rough morning ✨ Hailey’s Hangover Seafood Tofu Ramen 📝 Ingredients * 2–3 tbsp chili oil * 2 eggs * 1 green onion, chopped * 2–3 cloves garlic, sliced * 1 pack Shin Ramyun (soup base + veggie packet) * 2 cups water * 3–5 large shrimp (heads separated) * 1 small crab * Baby octopus * Soft tofu * Rice cakes * A handful of bok choy (or bean sprouts) * Fresh red chili, sliced 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp

How I Review My Lectures without Rereading Everything. 📚 Every semester starts the same. ✨ I tell myself I'll go back and review every lecture after class... but the slides just keep piling up, and when I finally have time to study, I don't even know where to start. 😅 So I changed one small thing in my routine. Now I open Kilonotes first. 📖 I import my lecture slides, let AI Summary pull out the key ideas, and start with a quick recap instead of reading everything from the beginning. ✍️ From there, I turn those ideas into notes that actually make sense to me, then create a few flashcards to test myself before moving on. 📝🃏 It doesn't make studying effortless, but it makes getting started so much easier. And I've realized that's usually the hardest part. 🤍 #Kilonotes #backtoschool #takenotes #studytok #studywithme

“But she’s just a corgi…”  Meet Maple the 4 year old Corgi.  Sweet in the right moments… but dangerous in the wrong ones. Resource guarding food and household items. Multiple bites on owners and family members. Reactive to other dogs on walks, barking & lunging. And now there’s a baby in the home. During the evaluation, Maple tried to bite me multiple times. Not because she’s a “bad dog”… But because she’s been making decisions for a long time without clear direction. No real structure. No consistent boundaries. No clear communication or expectations. And when you let “dogs be dogs” they do just that.  This is the part people struggle with.. You can love your dog deeply and still be missing the leadership they actually need. Honest question… Do you think dogs like Maple know they’re doing something wrong… or are they just doing what’s always worked for them? #DogTraining #dogtrainer #dogsoftiktok #dogs #dog

“Dog lovers” vs dog lovers when it comes to greeting dogs! ETA: “dog lovers” could also be replaced with “uniformed, uneducated, and/or inconsiderate dog lovers” vs “informed, educated, and considerate dog lovers” if that makes you more comfortable 🫶 One of my biggest pet peeves is people baby talking to my dog and pretending like I’m interrupting? Bizarre! And in case you didn’t know because it’s something that’s been so normalized, putting your hands in dogs’ faces is unsafe. Dogs don’t need to sniff you up close like that and it’s putting unneeded pressure on them (often leading to bites). The best way to greet a dog is calm, neutral, and honestly just ignoring them. If you want to say hi to a dog, ask the owner first. Try to make yourself small by turning to the side and crouching. Allow the dog to approach you first. Some dogs are super friendly and love people! This doesn’t mean it’s ok to pet or approach without asking their handler! The safest way to greet any dog is by admiring from afar. Admittedly, if I know someone’s dog well, I might be a bit of the former “dog lover” and be excitedly greeting them 😂 It’s different when you know the dog!
